user.title: DHL Shipment Tracking
user.description:
Configure DHL parcel tracking by entering your tracking numbers directly (Recommended).

⚠️ Note on DHL Account Connection: DHL does NOT offer automatic shipment import from your account. Cookie tokens are short-lived, complicated to extract, and offer minimal benefit. Manual tracking is strongly recommended.

data.auto_prune_delivered: Automatically delete delivered shipments from configuration
data.auto_prune_days: Days after delivery until automatic deletion (default: 14)

account_token.title: DHL Account — Session / Refresh Token (Experimental)
account_token.description:
⚠️ Note: Connecting an account does NOT automatically import shipments from DHL. Tokens expire quickly and must be renewed manually. Manual tracking is recommended.

If you still want to connect:
1. Log in to your DHL account at dhl.de in your browser.
2. Open Developer Tools (F12) > Application > Storage > Cookies > `https://www.dhl.de`.
3. Click on the cookie named `dhlr0` (refresh token) or `dhla0` (access token).
4. Copy the entire Value string (starts with `eyJ...`) and paste it here.

account_web.title: DHL Account — Web Auth Code (Experimental)
account_web.description:
⚠️ Note: DHL Account connection does NOT automatically import your shipments. Manual tracking number entry is recommended.

How to obtain your code:
1. Open the DHL authorization URL in your browser.
2. Complete login and 2FA verification.
3. Copy the authorization `code` parameter from the redirected URL in your browser address bar and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate DHL Account
reauth_confirm.description: Your DHL session token (`dhlr0` or `dhla0`) has expired as expected due to DHL token lifetimes. Please copy a fresh cookie value from dhl.de (DevTools > Application > Cookies) to resume, or switch to 'No account login' in integration options.
